title: Argentinian Duck Wrap
description: A German-inspired take on the classic wrap, featuring juicy Argentinian duck and silky wrap.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Grill the duck for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom half, followed by sliced duck, jalapeño, cheese, cilantro, and salsa.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
